notes: Visual transcription of the 12 'صفر تا صد' invoices sent on 1405/08/12 (3, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 9 stops; 10 stops: 15688 / 15691 on 1405/08/14, automatic and semi-automatic). Printed quantities are in 'printedQuantity'.
slot = the standard row of the app the printed row belongs to (RAIL:T5:rail = rail T5 ...). CAM = mechanical cam (retired), MDF = MDF-steel cabin (replaced by the all-steel cabin).
15663 is an 8-person list (flakeh 40x5, motor 7.3, controller 11); all others are 4-6 persons. Capacity rules (serbokosl, krapi, weight) of the client override the printed values.
In 15688 and 15691 the row printed 'براکت T9' after the T5 clip is the clip T9 (unit price 150,000, same as the clip).
